description:
More than a wine tour, this is an invitation to discover the breathtaking landscapes, and world-class wines that have made the Uco Valley - Mendoza, one of South America's premier wine destinations.

Your private experience begins with pickup from your accommodation in Mendoza. We'll travel south along the iconic Route 40 before heading west to the Uco Valley, about a 1 hour and 15 minute scenic drive.

Visit three carefully selected wineries. Enjoy guided tours and premium tastings at two wineries, followed by a gourmet multi-course lunch paired with local wines at the third.

Our favorite itinerary often includes Domaine Bousquet, Finca Adelma or Finca Sophenia, followed by Salentein, with lunch at Andeluna or La Azul. The itinerary may vary depending on availability, your interests, and language requirements.

Relax, admire the Andes mountains, and enjoy every glass while we take care of the driving.

We'll return to Mendoza around 5:30 p.m.

itineraryItems.description:
Located at about an hour drive from Mendoza City and at 1300 meters asl (4265 feets) the Uco Valley region is synonym of exceptional terroir and stunnings views of the Andes Mountains.
Uco Valley has become the paradigm of great Malbecs. 
In a setting of unparalleled beauty with the Andes as a backdrop and in a relaxed atmosphere we will visit different wineries and taste the best wines.
We are experts in the Uco Valley region and will choose for your the best places for visiting, tasting and having amazing argentinian lunch. 
Come with us for your unforgettable day in Uco Valley 
During the tour we visit 3 wineries:
- 2 wineries for visit and tasting of 4/5 wines
- A 3rd winery for a delicious courses lunch paired with wines.
IMPORTANT! : for tasting and lunch during the day consider around usd 150 per person (in the "All inclusive" option that is included).
WE LIST 6 WINERIES but keep in mind that during a day we visit 3 of them.

Option: FINCA ADELMA Winery
Finca Adelma is a small, family-run winery where you can enjoy a warm, personalized experience, tasting exquisite wines paired with cheeses and delicious empanadas. It’s a perfect complement to a visit to a larger winery—like our favorite among the big names, Bodega Salentein—and a great way to see how small and large players coexist in the majestic Uco Valley. We love Finca Adelma!

Domaine Bousquet: Organic. Biodynamics. Domaine Bousquet is a renowned winery known for its high-altitude vineyards and commitment to organic and sustainable winemaking practices. The winery has an breathtaking view of the Andes. 
Tasting is around USD 25

Salentein is known as the Cathedral of the Vallley. 
And we consider it the perfect match of majestic arquitecture, combined with a world class art gallery, breathtaking landscape, one of its kind cellar and very good wines. 
It is a "Must" of the Valley!
We usually include SALENTEIN; but is also possible to customize your day, including some other winery.
Visit and tasting at Salentein is about USD 30 per person

Set in the heart of the Andes Mountains, Bodega Andeluna delivers one of Mendoza’s most captivating wine experiences. Elegant architecture, pristine vineyards, and endless mountain views create a stunning backdrop, while warm, attentive service elevates every moment. Guests consistently highlight not only the quality of the wines, but the seamless blend of scenery, gastronomy, and personalized hospitality—designed to be savored and remembered.
Four courses lunch paired with wines is around USD 85
